tools.name: subagent
tools.description: Hand a task to a separate agent with its own fresh context and get back only its final answer. Agents only read unless marked [can change files]. Use it for searches or reading that would fill your context. A slow agent returns a run id while it keeps working; never start the task again: use the async tool with that id to wait for it, look at it or stop it. [can change files; runs to its end] is never handed off. [can change files; may run in the background] is handed off, keeps editing after your turn ends and cannot ask the user: leave its paths alone until it ends.

task.description: Self-contained instructions. The agent sees nothing of this conversation. Omit to list the agents.

agent.description: Agent name. Optional when only one is configured.

block_ms.description: Most time this call blocks for the answer; 0 returns a run id at once. Clamped to the async policy. An agent marked [can change files; runs to its end] ignores it and runs to its end.
